meta.title: EduKit — a platform for teachers in Kazakhstan
meta.description: An education platform: AI tools for lesson preparation, classroom games, assignments and a gradebook. In development.

landing.title: Less routine, more time for students
landing.subtitle: EduKit helps teachers in Kazakhstan prepare lessons, run classroom games, check student work and keep a gradebook in Kazakh, Russian and English.
landing.pilotNote: The platform is in development. Sign-up will open for closed pilot participants; working features will be enabled step by step.

ai.title: AI generators
ai.text: 12 categories of teaching materials: lesson plans, term plans, summative assessments, tests, presentations and more. Every result is editable.

games.title: Classroom games
games.text: 14 game templates for classes of up to 30 participants. Game results never affect grades.

assessment.title: Assignments and gradebook
assessment.text: Assignments, AI-assisted checking and a gradebook. The teacher approves every grade.

organizations.title: Schools and classes
organizations.text: Workspaces for directors, deputies, homeroom teachers, teachers and students with separated access.

landing.pricingNote: Prices are approved. The amount of AI credits in each plan will be set after measurements during the pilot. EduKit is free for students.

faq.a: The platform will first open for a closed pilot with teachers. The date will be announced separately.
No. Students use EduKit for free and have no access to paid features.
